0.name: B
0.text: You’re looking kind of restless there.

1.name: B
1.text: What’s up? Want to ask me something?

5.name: B
5.text: Divorced parents, finished highschool, left home, got a job as a mechanic, and here I am.

6.name: B
6.text: I got friends, I drink beer, I drive a beast of a bike with an engine that purrs like a lover.

7.name: B
7.text: What more could I want? “Nothing”’s what I say.

8.name: B
8.text: Now it’s me who gets to ask you something.

9.name: B
9.text: You keeping yourself safe out here? When I was driving around, I heard about some convenience stores near the city getting into trouble.

10.name: B
10.text: And you’re working in one right now.

11.name: B
11.text: Kind of mushy, but you look like a fine kid, different from the rabble, and I don’t want to see ya on the news.

13.name: B
13.text: I’ll take that as a “I’m very much fine by myself and I thank you kindly for taking the time to ask about it”, then.

14.name: B
14.text: Now, if you don’t mind, gotta hit the road.

15.name: B
15.text: Nice talking to you. Stay safe.
